paragraphs.text: Local proxy for DeepSeek Harness: keep recent turns verbatim and summarize older context.
Local reverse proxy between DeepSeek Harness (or any OpenAI-compatible client) and your LLM gateway.
It **keeps recent turns verbatim** and **summarizes older context**, so the same chat can continue
Daily use: start `python proxy.py` in a **foreground terminal** (see Quick Start below).
## Set up with a coding agent
Copy this into your coding agent:

No fork, no npm, no TLS termination. A plain HTTP reverse proxy on `127.0.0.1` runs **keep-recent /
summarize-old + rolling merge** on OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions`. Offline CLI is emergency-only.
